item.content:encoded:
A) https://m.youtube.com/watch?v=MAW2lygZC_4

In case it's still too vague, I fucking love space and I love lots of space-related shit. So I write it fancy-like to imply that. Except, maybe I wrote it too fancy-like so that you didn't understand?

B) I dunno - references to kids becoming cadets, leaving Earth in a pseudo-paramilitary outfit, etc.? It's just a personal thing.

C) I like tales that take place in the period where human civilization is transitioning to a place where interplanetary/stellar travel becomes commonplace - melding the cultures of traditional Science Fiction with those of People.

Tl;dr you're not dumb and i was unintentionally vague as shit.

item.title: Welcome to Agent MacLeod's Coldpost Theater!
item.content:encoded:
Spiritual rewrite of Aftermath. Post-SCP-2217 world where the Foundation is forced out of hiding and the Church of the Broken God becomes a mainstream religion. Same continuity as PoI File #2273/01. Inspired by some stories shared with me by Luther Crackenthorpe in IRC. Seed of the idea can be found here.

Not much else to say, I think.
